sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Technology stands alone as the sole all-green sector with dominant 0.933 momentum, while narrow breadth and slipping ranks in Healthcare signal emerging divergence under the surface.

Broad market participation remains tightly constrained, with only 1 of 11 sectors showing positive performance across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD). Leadership is anchored by Technology and Energy, while Communication Services and Industrials represent the few pockets showing short-term upward rotation.

Meanwhile, rate-sensitive and cyclical sectors are heavily lagging, with Real Estate and Utilities trapped at the bottom of the momentum rankings. Healthcare presents the clearest sign of internal fatigue, retaining high absolute momentum but beginning to lose ground over the last five sessions.

## Strength
- **Technology dominates:** Represents the only all-green group across 1-week, 1-month, 1-quarter, 1-half, and YTD windows, boasting a 0.933 momentum score and sustained top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Energy anchors the top spot:** Holds the #1 YTD rank with solid momentum of 0.783, maintaining its position over the past five sessions.
- **Narrow overall breadth:** Just 1 of 11 groups displays all-green status, highlighting thin leadership at the top of the market.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Communication Services accelerating:** Posted the largest short-term advance, climbing +2 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 7 with a 0.583 momentum score.
- **Industrials edging higher:** Gained +1 spot over 5 sessions to reach rank 4, posting a balanced momentum score of 0.500.
- **Persistent laggards:** Real Estate (rank 9, momentum 0.117), Utilities (rank 10, momentum 0.267), and Consumer Cyclical (rank 11, momentum 0.367) remain anchored at the bottom of the momentum curve.

## Divergences
- **Healthcare fading:** Despite posting the third-highest momentum score on the board (0.633), Healthcare dropped -1 spot over the last 5 sessions to rank 5, indicating momentum exhaustion.
- **Broad-based slip in defensive and financial groups:** Financials (momentum 0.383) and Real Estate (momentum 0.117) both slid -1 spot over the past 5 sessions, deepening their positions in the lower quartile of YTD performance.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** High-momentum technology and energy leaders continue to anchor market strength, while retail and utilities show short-term rotation against fading real estate and housing-sensitive groups.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated, with only 11 of 144 groups all-green across time horizons. Dominance is held by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.992, rank_ytd 2) alongside key hardware and tech plays, including Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.958) and Semiconductors (momentum 0.925). Software - Infrastructure also demonstrated dual strength, holding all-green status while jumping 11 spots over the past 5 sessions to rank 35 (momentum 0.84). 

Short-term rotation favored defensive and consumer pockets, led by Utilities - Independent Power Producers (+17 spots to rank 119), Discount Stores (+15 spots to rank 68), and Internet Retail (+15 spots to rank 65). Conversely, deterioration is accelerating in interest-rate-sensitive and physical property segments: Real Estate - Development slipped 14 spots to rank 92 (momentum 0.23), Residential Construction fell 11 spots to rank 111 (momentum 0.21), and REIT - Mortgage remains anchored at the bottom of the market (momentum 0.042, rank_ytd 133).

## Strength
- **Core Leaders:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.992), Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.958), and Communication Equipment (momentum 0.946) post the highest momentum scores market-wide.
- **Persistent Breadth:** Just 11 groups are all-green across all timeframes, with sustained multi-month strength visible in Semiconductors (momentum 0.93), Marine Shipping (momentum 0.91), and Software - Infrastructure (momentum 0.84).
- **Diagnostics Outlier:** Diagnostics & Research remains among the few sustained strong performers across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons despite short-term consolidation.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Advancers:** Utilities - Independent Power Producers jumped 17 spots (rank 119, momentum 0.58), while Discount Stores gained 15 spots (rank 68, momentum 0.62) and Internet Retail rose 15 spots (rank 65, momentum 0.72).
- **Healthcare Improvement:** Medical Distribution climbed 14 spots to rank 59 (momentum 0.77), and Healthcare Plans moved up 12 spots to rank 29 (momentum 0.65).
- **Severe Decliners:** Shell Companies plummeted 42 spots (rank 72, momentum 0.64), Biotechnology dropped 15 spots (rank 43, momentum 0.52), and Lumber & Wood Production fell 13 spots (rank 83, momentum 0.31).
- **Absolute Laggards:** REIT - Mortgage (0.042), Mortgage Finance (0.051), Resorts & Casinos (0.075), and Advertising Agencies (0.077) represent the absolute bottom tier of relative momentum.

## Divergences
- **Momentum Fading:** Shell Companies shows severe degradation (-42 spots over 5 sessions despite 0.64 momentum), alongside subtle rank slippage in higher-momentum groups like Diagnostics & Research (-5 spots, momentum 0.76) and Health Information Services (-3 spots, momentum 0.72).
- **Early Emerging Rebounds:** Insurance - Specialty advanced 9 spots despite weak underlying momentum of 0.37, while Security & Protection Services gained 9 spots (momentum 0.52).
- **Early Value Rotation:** Uranium and Leisure each improved 5 spots over the last 5 sessions, yet both carry low momentum scores of 0.27 and 0.38, respectively.
